notes:
Summary: Enterprise bank evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private control plane for customer-facing chat and back-office reranking. Primary constraints: strict data residency for EU customers, SSO + audit trail requirements, and predictable unit economics for peak trading-hours traffic. POC scope agreed: 7-day Dedicated capacity trial using mixed workload (chat + reranking).

Performance & SLA discussion (customer language / shorthand):
- Target SLOs: p50 token-latency <= 60ms, p95 token-latency <= 220ms for chat at 200 qps steady-state; reranking p95 end-to-end <= 600ms for top-10 reranks.
- Throughput guarantees: need 200 sustained qps with 2x headroom for burst (target peak 400 qps for 15-min windows).
- Availability: require SLA negotiation for 99.95% uptime and incident notification within 15 minutes for P1.

Reserved GPU planning & topology notes:
- Customer prefers reserved capacity model: estimate initial commit = 2x A100-80GB equiv nodes / region (NA + EU) + burst pool (shared) for spikes.
- Proposed config: 2 reserved workers + 1 burst worker per region; autoscale policy to add up to 4 additional on-demand GPUs for <30-min bursts.
- Asking for a runbook: warmup strategy, KV-cache priming, and recommended padding for long-context sessions.

Model-specific dedicated tuning requests (detailed):
- Models in scope: mix of open Llama-family 70B for highest-quality chat and 13B/7B quantized variants for cost-sensitive fallback.
- Context-length: need support for up to 16k tokens for document-understanding flows. Want benchmarking for 8k vs 16k context in Dedicated runtime (memory footprint + throughput curves).
- Quantization profile: customer prefers int8/4-bit where possible. Observed perf regression on 70B int8 in initial tests -> request Redwood to run quantization profile sweep (FP16 baseline, int8 dynamic, int8 calibrated, GPTQ-4bit) and provide recommended profile per model family.
- Batching / KV cache: typical chat sessions show many short-turn interactions; recommended strategy: dynamic batching with max batch=12 for chat, continuous KV caching enabled across session lifetime. Need guidance on batch delay trade-offs to keep p95 latency targets.
- Prefix caching: high value for reranking precomputed embeddings; ask for advice on cache TTLs and invalidation policies to balance freshness vs cost.

Operational / security notes:
- VPC private control plane required; full audit logging sent to their SIEM. KMS integration mandatory for key management. EU tenant must keep customer PII in EU region.
- Legal: data residency clause requested; waiting on Legal to sign DPA addendum.

Quotes / direct:
- "We need predictable numbers for capacity planning — if we reserve GPUs we want hard throughput guarantees for business hours"
- "If int8 on 70B can't meet p95, we will fall back to 13B but need to quantify quality delta"

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Demonstrate p95 token-latency <= 250ms for chat under replayed live traces at 200 qps
- Show stable throughput for 3x sustained load without significant error rate increase
- Provide a quantization report with recommended profiles and sample outputs to audit quality degradation (ROUGE/EM/Manual samples)

Next steps (practical):
- Redwood to provide SOW + pricing sheet by 11/12
- Schedule capacity planning workshop with infra team (2hr deep dive) week of 11/18
- Run 7-day Dedicated POC starting 11/25 (customer to provide replay traces and acceptance tests)
